_transcription: ENGLISH half only, CBSE Class 10 Mathematics Standard (041), Series WX1YZ/6, SET 3, Q.P. Code 30/6/3. 24 pages (idx 0-23): idx 0 bilingual cover, idx 1 Hindi instructions + Hindi Q1; English on every even index 2-22, Hindi on every odd index 1-21 (each the Hindi of the page after it); odd-page tops checked on the contact sheet, all Hindi (idx 17 opens with the Hindi Q34 table, idx 19 the Hindi Q36 parts, idx 21 the Hindi Q38); idx 23 is blank (folio only, no English); last English page idx 22. No usable text layer: every row read off the page images. General Instructions (i)-(x) confirm full80. Instruction (viii) prints 2 internal choices in B, 2 in C, 2 in D and 3 in E: Q22, Q23, Q27, Q31, Q32, Q33, Q36, Q37, Q38, all found on the paper, and the marking-scheme walk (ms idx 2-20, scheme for 30/6/3 only, footer MS_X_Mathematics_041_30/6/3_2022-23) shows exactly these nine OR blocks. Case-study alternatives sit unlabelled inside part (ii) (worth 2), so refs Q36iia/Q36iib etc. Q37 prints no per-part marks on the paper; 1/2/1 is from the scheme's split. Section-A keys read off the scheme as images and each re-derived: all 20 agree; no void notes. Decimal points are ORDINARY full stops on this paper (Q12 20.25 cm, Q13 2.25 cm); the scheme prints raised dots. Sibling of 30/6/1: plan.txt was not used for skipping (it is unreliable for 2023); every question was matched by CONTENT against data/2023-30-6-1.questions.json and confirmed on this paper's page. 37 of 53 rows reuse the reference text byte for byte (checked by script); 16 are transcribed fresh: 14 questions new to this set (Q1, Q2, Q3, Q16, Q17, Q18, Q21, Q26, Q27(A), Q27(B), Q32(A), Q32(B), Q33(A), Q33(B)), plus Q9 (prints 'and the y-axis' where 30/6/1 Q4 prints 'and y-axis') and Q23(B) (prints 'Find the LCM and HCF of 72 and 120' with no full stop, where 30/6/1 Q21(B) prints 'Find the HCF and LCM of 72 and 120.'). Typesetting-only slips copied from the reference: Q34(ii) prints no full stop after 'apples'; Q24 closes with a raised dot after the fraction, a sentence full stop. Section E prints no 'Case Study - N' headings, so no _caseStudyLabel.

questions.context: In question numbers 19 and 20, a statement of Assertion (A) is followed by a statement of Reason (R). Choose the correct option out of the following :
questions.stem:
**Statement A (Assertion) :** For \(0 < \theta \leq 90^\circ\), \(\operatorname{cosec}\theta - \cot\theta\) and \(\operatorname{cosec}\theta + \cot\theta\) are reciprocal of each other.

**Statement R (Reason) :** \(\operatorname{cosec}^2\theta - \cot^2\theta = 1\)

options.label: A
options.text: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true; and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).

options.label: B
options.text: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true; but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).

options.label: C
options.text: Assertion (A) is true but Reason (R) is false.

options.label: D
options.text: Assertion (A) is false but Reason (R) is true.
